_about: Public-domain R. W. Church (Richard William Church, 1815-1890, Rector of Whatley, then Dean of St Paul's) for the Word Hoard: The Oxford Movement: Twelve Years 1833-1845 (clean from Gutenberg), and as raw Internet Archive OCR Saint Anselm (1870), The Gifts of Civilisation (new edition, 1880), The Discipline of the Christian Character (1885), Pascal and Other Sermons (1896 reprint), Village Sermons Preached at Whatley (3 series, 1899-1901 reprints) and Occasional Papers (2 vols, 1897). Not Alfred John Church, whose retellings have the separate church shelf. Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 14 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.

rwchurch-gifts-of-civilisation-1880: The Gifts of Civilisation and Other Sermons and Lectures, new edition (London: Macmillan, 1880)
rwchurch-discipline-1885: The Discipline of the Christian Character (London: Macmillan, 1885)
rwchurch-pascal-sermons-1896: Pascal and Other Sermons (London: Macmillan, 1896 reprint of the 1895 first edition)
rwchurch-village-sermons-1: Village Sermons Preached at Whatley, first series (London and New York: Macmillan, 1899 reprint)
rwchurch-village-sermons-2: Village Sermons Preached at Whatley, second series (London and New York: Macmillan, 1899 reprint)
rwchurch-village-sermons-3: Village Sermons Preached at Whatley, third series (London and New York: Macmillan, 1901 reprint)
rwchurch-occasional-papers-1: Occasional Papers selected from the Guardian, the Times, and the Saturday Review, 1846-1890, vol. 1 (London and New York: Macmillan, 1897)
rwchurch-occasional-papers-2: Occasional Papers selected from the Guardian, the Times, and the Saturday Review, 1846-1890, vol. 2 (London and New York: Macmillan, 1897)
